title: Injective projective-module maps over a nil local ring are pure
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a commutative local ring (a commutative ring with unique maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$) such that every element of $\mathfrak m$ is nilpotent. Let $P,Q$ be projective $A$-modules [def-weil-pbc-projective-module], without any finite-generation assumption, and let $u:P\to Q$ be an injective $A$-linear map. Then $u$ is universally injective: for every $A$-module $T$, the map $1_T\otimes u:T\otimes_A P\to T\otimes_A Q$ is injective [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. In particular $u\otimes_A A/\mathfrak m$ is injective.
